title: Beginning performance and mere preparation
summary: The significance of an act depends on whether the offer invites it and whether the issue is formation or protection against revocation.
notes: White’s generic private carpentry preparation did not manifest acceptance. Ever-Tite’s loading and dispatch of materials began the performance its form invited. Section 45 protects beginning or tendering the performance of a performance-only offer; § 87(2), discussed through Drennan, asks separately about preparatory reliance. A single label such as “started work” obscures the different legal functions.
